answer: Dock every new identity at the jetty before it may trade: it must complete a supervised voyage of five real jobs, each paid into escrow and released only after a delayed independent re-check, like jade inspected twice before sale. Post a 20,000 POA voyage deposit per identity; fielding 1,000 fakes locks 20,000,000 POA, while one honest agent posts 20,000 once and gets it back after the voyage. Fail any leg and the deposit is burned, half paid to the auditor who caught it, and the identity is banned for 10 epochs. Limitation: the voyage delays an honest newcomer's income by a full epoch.
